name: Bullpen — Part 4 (planned)
description: Prediction, not yet built: placing a paper trade becomes a multi-step order saga, carried forward on top of Part 3's data split. An Orders Service accepts trade requests, a workflow engine orchestrates the saga (price lookup, balance check, fill, ledger update), and a Ledger Service owns player balances and positions as its own data boundary.

nodes.name: Reader
nodes.description: A blog reader exploring Bullpen's architecture timeline on the landing site.

nodes.name: Player
nodes.description: A registered player who places paper trade orders.

nodes.name: Bullpen Landing
nodes.description: The public landing site with the architecture timeline explorer.

nodes.name: Bullpen Trading App
nodes.description: The trading app where players view prices and history and submit paper trade orders.

nodes.name: Prices Service
nodes.description: Owns live price snapshots, consulted by the order saga at fill time.

nodes.name: Prices Database
nodes.description: Neon Postgres database owned solely by the Prices Service.

nodes.name: Market History Service
nodes.description: Serves historical price/candle queries independently of live snapshots, with its own write path and own database.

nodes.name: Market History Database
nodes.description: Neon Postgres database owned solely by the Market History Service.

nodes.name: Orders Service
nodes.description: Accepts paper trade order requests from the trading app and starts an order saga for each one.

nodes.name: Order Saga
nodes.description: Durable workflow orchestrating each order: price lookup, balance check, fill, and ledger update, with compensation if any step fails.

nodes.name: Ledger Service
nodes.description: Owns player balances and positions as an independent data boundary, updated only by the order saga.

nodes.name: Stock data provider
nodes.description: External market-data API for U.S. stock prices. Alpha Vantage is proposed (free tier, end of day), pending written permission for public display — see ADR-0008.

relationships.description: Reader browses the public landing site.
Trading app requests a live price snapshot for a symbol.
Trading app requests historical price/candle data for a symbol.
Trading app submits a paper trade order request.
Orders Service starts an order saga for each accepted order.
Order saga consults the Prices Service for the fill price.
Order saga updates the player's balance and positions once a trade fills.
Prices Service calls out to the external market-data provider for the current price.
Prices Service persists and reads live price snapshots.
Market History Service persists and reads historical price/candle data.
